newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Tsang wants unit to help business, services.
newsitem.headline: HK's Tsang wants unit to help business, services.

text.p: Hong Kong Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said in his 1997/98 budget speech on Wednesday he had set aside funding for a government unit to "take responsibility for both helping business and services promotion".

"I propose to create a new unit to take responsibility for both helping business and services promotion, and I have identified the resources for the purpose," Tsang said, adding that the head of the group would report directly to him.
